mappings.annotation: Ayat al-Kursi — Allah's oneness, life, and sovereignty
Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad — the essence of tawhid
Allah us-Samad — the Self-Sufficient
Neither begets nor is begotten
None is comparable to Him
Allah bears witness that there is no deity but Him
Indeed, I am Allah; there is no deity except Me
Know that there is no deity except Allah
There is no deity but Allah
He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity
Allah's names and attributes
That is Allah, your Lord; there is no deity except Him
Your god is one God
Do not take two deities; indeed, He is but one God
There is no deity except Me, so worship Me
Allah has not taken any son, nor has there been any deity with Him
Praise to Allah who has not taken a son
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds
Say: Allah is the Creator of all things, the One
Allah is the Creator of all things
No deity except Him, Creator of all things
Is there any creator other than Allah?
Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth?
O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you
To whom belongs the earth and whoever is on it?
Worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance
I did not create jinn and mankind except to worship Me
O mankind, worship your Lord
They were not commanded except to worship Allah alone
My prayer, my rites, my life, and my death are for Allah
Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon; prostrate to Allah
Worship Allah and avoid Taghut
There is no deity except Me, so worship Me
He is Allah — the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed
The Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfector, the Almighty
He is Allah, the Creator, the Evolver; to Him belong the best names
Allah — there is no deity except Him; to Him belong the best names
To Allah belong the best names; invoke Him by them
The Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence
Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful
He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near
Allah us-Samad
Muhammad is not the father of any of your men, but the Messenger of Allah
Muhammad is not but a messenger
Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds
In the Messenger of Allah you have an excellent example
Allah conferred a great favor upon the believers by sending a Messenger
Just as We have sent among you a Messenger from yourselves
We have sent to every nation a messenger
For every nation is a messenger
There was no nation but that a warner had passed within it
He has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves
O mankind, I am the Messenger of Allah to you all
Fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah
Every soul will taste death, and you will only be given your compensation on the Day of Resurrection
We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection
When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it
The Striking Calamity
When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
When the sky breaks apart
The Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and earth will fall unconscious
He who created death and life to test you — which of you is best in deed
The record [of deeds] will be placed, and you will see the criminals fearful
The Horn is blown; that is the Day of the Threat
The Horn will be blown, and suddenly they will rush from their graves
Give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds — gardens beneath which rivers flow
Race to forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden as wide as the heavens and the earth
We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever
The example of Paradise promised to the righteous — rivers of water, milk, wine, and honey
Gardens and silk for the patient
Faces that Day will be pleasant, with their effort satisfied
For whoever fears the standing of his Lord are two gardens
Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with the righteous among their fathers
The forerunners — those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
For the righteous are gardens with their Lord beneath which rivers flow
Fear the Fire whose fuel is people and stones
Fear the Fire prepared for the disbelievers
Indeed, those who disbelieve in Our verses, We will drive them into a Fire
The Fire of Hell; abide therein forever
Garments of fire will be cut out for them, and scalding water poured over their heads
I will drive him into Saqar
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones
We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense
Fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah
The Horn will be blown, and they will rush from their graves
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense
The people will depart separated into categories to be shown their deeds
The scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection
Every soul will be recompensed that Day for what it earned
He asks: when is the Day of Resurrection?
I did not create jinn and mankind except to worship Me
Establish prayer for My remembrance
They were not commanded except to worship Allah, being sincere to Him
Establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow
My prayer, my rites, my life, and my death are for Allah
Worship none but Allah; be dutiful to parents
O mankind, worship your Lord
Establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow
Maintain the prayers and the middle prayer
Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers at specified times
Establish prayer at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night
Establish prayer for My remembrance
Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer; prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing
He has succeeded who purifies himself and mentions the name of his Lord and prays
When you rise to prayer, wash your faces and hands
Seek help through patience and prayer
And [part] of the night, exalt Him and after the prostrations
Establish prayer and give zakah
Establish prayer and give zakah; whatever good you put forward for yourselves
Righteousness is to believe in Allah... and give zakah
Those who believe and do righteous deeds and establish prayer and give zakah
Zakah expenditures are only for the poor and the needy
Take from their wealth a charity by which you purify them
Whatever you give for interest to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allah
Establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger
Establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan
O you who believe, fasting has been decreed upon you as it was decreed upon those before you
A limited number of days; whoever is ill or on a journey, then an equal number of other days
The month of Ramadan, in which the Quran was revealed; so whoever sights the month, let him fast it
It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting
The men who fast and the women who fast — Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward
I have vowed a fast to the Most Merciful, so I will not speak today to any human
Contextual mention of fasting among righteous women
Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah
Complete the hajj and the umrah for Allah
Hajj is [during] well-known months
Pilgrimage to the House is a duty upon mankind for Allah
Proclaim to the people the hajj; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel
That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on known days
Do not violate the rites of Allah or the sacred month
Enter houses from their doors and fear Allah
Allah commands justice, good conduct, and giving to relatives
Be persistently standing firm in justice, witnesses for Allah
O mankind, We created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another
Do not let a people ridicule another people
Avoid much assumption; do not spy or backbite
Your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him and be dutiful to parents
Speak to people good words
By time — mankind is in loss, except those who believe and do righteous deeds
Speak words of appropriate justice
Allah commands you to render trusts to their owners and judge with justice
Be persistently standing firm in justice, even against yourselves or parents
Let not hatred of a people prevent you from being just; be just; it is nearer to righteousness
Allah commands justice and good conduct
If two factions among the believers fight, make peace between them with justice
Establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance
We sent Our messengers with clear proofs and the Book and the balance that people may maintain justice
When you speak, be just, even if it should be to a near relative
Seek help through patience and prayer
O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer; indeed, Allah is with the patient
We will surely test you with something of fear, hunger, and loss of wealth; give good tidings to the patient
O you who believe, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah
If you punish, punish with an equivalent; but if you are patient, it is better for the patient
The patient will be given their reward without account
Then he is among those who believed and advised one another to patience
Except those who believe, do righteous deeds, and advise one another to truth and patience
Except those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward
Remember Me; I will remember you. Be grateful to Me and do not deny Me
Eat of the good things We have provided for you and be grateful to Allah
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]
If you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them
Whoever is grateful is grateful for the benefit of himself
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Seek provision from Allah and worship Him and be grateful to Him
O mankind, fear your Lord who created you from one soul
We made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another; the most noble of you is the most righteous
Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet; send blessings upon him and greet him with peace
Do not wish for what Allah has given some of you over others
Cooperate in righteousness and piety, and do not cooperate in sin and aggression
Allah commands justice, good conduct, and giving to relatives
Be dutiful to parents, relatives, orphans, and the needy, and speak to people good words
Do not enter houses other than your own until you ask permission
The believers are but brothers, so make peace between your brothers
Allah does not forbid you from being righteous and just toward those who have not fought you
Give the relative his right, and the poor and the traveler
We sent Noah to his people — the story of Nuh
We sent to 'Ad their brother Hud — the story of Hud
We sent to Thamud their brother Salih — the story of Salih
We sent to Madyan their brother Shu'ayb — the story of Shu'ayb
Then We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh — the story of Musa
The companions of al-Hijr denied the messengers — the story of Thamud's stone dwellings
And 'Ad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them
We sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty
The Companions of the Cave — story of the youths of the cave
We gave David and Solomon knowledge — the story of Dawud and Sulayman
When Joseph said to his father: I saw eleven stars — the story of Yusuf
And he said: Indeed, I will go to my Lord — the story of Ibrahim's sacrifice
When his Lord tested Abraham with words — the trials of Ibrahim
Has the story of Moses reached you?
Has there reached you the story of Moses?
Has there reached you the story of the soldiers?
Did you not consider how your Lord dealt with 'Ad?
Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day are signs
In the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day are signs for those of understanding
Indeed, within the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers
On the earth are signs for the certain, and in yourselves — do you not see?
He who created the seven heavens in layers
Do they not look at the camels — how they were created?
Travel through the land and observe how He began creation
Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky, producing fruits of varying colors?
Your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days
Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke
Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and colors
A sign for them is the dead earth — We brought it to life
Your Lord inspired the bee to take homes in the mountains
Guide us to the straight path
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for the righteous
The month of Ramadan in which was revealed the Quran, a guidance for the people
Indeed, this Quran guides to that which is most suitable
Whoever Allah wants to guide — He expands his breast to Islam
Whoever follows My guidance will not go astray nor suffer
Allah has sent down the best statement, a Book consistent in its verses
These are verses of the wise Book, a guidance and mercy for the doers of good
When guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will have no fear
O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts
We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy
O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you
Whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed — those are the disbelievers
Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you — do not associate anything with Him
Your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him and be dutiful to parents
The fornicatress and fornicator — lash each one of them a hundred lashes
Allah instructs you concerning your children's inheritance
Divorce is twice; then keep them in reasonable honor or release them with kindness
Allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest (riba)
Intoxicants, gambling, idols, and divining arrows are abomination of Satan's work; avoid them
Do not consume one another's wealth unjustly
O you who believe, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down
The thief, male and female, amputate their hands in recompense for what they committed
If two factions fight, make peace between them with justice
